review:
Joker Mask is a 3x5 classic from BGaming and LudexPlay with realistic fruit symbols, coins and animated, emotional masks above the reels that react to play.

Collect symbols appear only on reel 2. When a collector lands with coins on reels 1 and 3, all coin values are added together and paid, and the masks laugh. That combination also leads into a Hold and Win bonus with multipliers and progressive win opportunities. BGaming rates the game high volatility with a 15,000x maximum and a 96.12% RTP, a big ceiling for a classic fruit design.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
